title: Frequent main evidence pushes cancel active verification before it can complete
reproduction: Push a source change to main and observe its active CI run.
Push a subsequent evidence-only commit to the same main ref before the checks finish.
Observe ci-${github.ref} cancel-in-progress true cancel the prior verification; repeated pushes starve completion.
expected: Main verification finishes for its immutable source; newer main work remains queued. Pull-request superseded checks may cancel.
actual: Multiple main CI runs were cancelled by later evidence pushes, including37099813858,37099983831,37101068256 and37101482506.
severity: S2: integration evidence repeatedly unavailable and compute wasted

transition_history.reason: Ref-scoped cancel-in-progress true reproduced by following main pushes.
Assigned narrow PR-only cancellation change to runtime escalation lane.
25845342 preserves active main checks and only cancels superseded PR runs; independent source and live overlap retest pending.

closure_requirement: Fresh peer verifies concurrency semantics; following main push leaves current run active/completed rather than cancelled and latest pending run proceeds.
